snippet.title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian – System Introduction Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://atelier.games/resleriana_rw/uk/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=SystemUK&utm_id=Caption  

Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian is coming to PlayStation®5, Nintendo Switch™ and Steam® on 26th September 2025. 

In this video, take a deep dive into the main system mechanics of the game including synthesis, battles, exploration, shop management and town development.
